PRIVACY POLICY

How we handle your information.

This policy explains the information Cyberfreak Software Limited uses, why we use it and the choices available to you.

Last updated: 17 November 2026

Cyberfreak Software Limited (“CFS”, “we”, “us” or “our”) is committed to handling personal information responsibly. This policy applies to this website, enquiries submitted through its contact form and information handled when providing our services, including SEO Management, website deployments and software work. It is designed to be a clear explanation of our current practices; if a particular project involves additional processing, we will discuss that with the customer as part of the service arrangement.

Who is responsible for your information

Cyberfreak Software Limited is the organisation responsible for the personal information described in this policy. You can contact us about privacy through the website contact form by selecting “Privacy question”. Please include enough detail for us to understand and respond to your request. Our registered company number is 16445225.

Information we collect

When you contact us, we collect the information you choose to provide, which may include your name, email address, business name, website address, subject and message. We also receive the page from which the enquiry was sent so that we can understand the context of your request. We ask only for the information needed to respond to an enquiry or discuss possible work.

When we provide services, the information we handle depends on the agreed scope. It can include client contact and account information, website and domain details, service requirements, correspondence, project records, invoices and payment-administration information. We do not ask customers to send passwords through the contact form or ordinary email. Access credentials should be shared through an appropriate method agreed for the service.

SEO Management information

SEO Management may involve access to Google Search Console and related website information. This can include search-performance data, search queries, clicks, impressions, indexing information, website and domain details, sitemap configuration, verification information and monthly reports. We use this information to configure and provide the agreed monitoring service, maintain the relevant search setup, analyse performance and prepare reports and recommendations.

This work may require limited access to website administration, hosting or domain-verification systems. We only request access that is reasonably necessary for the agreed work. Any substantial website changes remain subject to separate discussion and authorisation. Google Search Console and other third-party services involved in a customer’s website or reporting arrangement process information under their own terms and privacy documentation.

Why we use information

We use personal information to respond to enquiries, assess and provide requested services, communicate with customers, manage our business records, protect the website and systems, and meet legal or accounting obligations. We do not sell personal information. We do not use contact-form submissions to make solely automated decisions about people.

Depending on the context, our lawful basis is taking steps at your request before entering a contract, performing a contract with a customer, complying with a legal obligation, or pursuing our legitimate interests in operating and protecting a professional services business. Where we rely on legitimate interests, we consider whether the use is necessary and whether it unfairly affects the individual concerned.

Who receives information

Access to information is limited to people who need it to respond to an enquiry, deliver or support an agreed service, or meet our legal obligations. Our contact form sends its submission to the existing CFS contact service. For SEO Management, information may also be available within customer-authorised Google Search Console properties and the relevant website, hosting or domain services. We do not share personal information for third-party advertising.

Our website uses external technical resources such as content-delivery and font services. Those providers may receive ordinary connection information, such as an IP address and browser request, when your browser loads their resources. We do not currently operate advertising or analytics cookies on this website. If that changes, we will update this policy and provide any notice or controls required for the new use.

How long we keep information

We keep information only for as long as reasonably necessary for the purpose for which it was collected, including responding to an enquiry, providing the agreed service, maintaining relevant business records and meeting legal obligations. The appropriate period varies with the nature of the information and service. When information is no longer needed, we will delete it or securely anonymise it where appropriate.

Security

We use reasonable organisational and technical measures to protect information from unauthorised access, loss, alteration or disclosure. No website, service or transmission method can be guaranteed completely secure, so you should take care with the information you send online and avoid sending passwords or unnecessary sensitive information through the contact form.

Your rights and choices

Subject to applicable law, you may have rights to request access to your personal information, ask for correction or erasure, object to certain processing, request restriction, or ask for a portable copy in relevant circumstances. Where processing is based on consent, you may withdraw that consent. To make a request, contact us through the website and select “Privacy question”. We may need to verify your identity before responding.

If you are unhappy with how we handle your information, please contact us first so that we can try to resolve the issue. You also have the right to raise a concern with the UK Information Commissioner’s Office.

Children and third-party websites

This site is intended for businesses and adults seeking information about our services. We do not knowingly seek personal information from children through this website. Our website may link to third-party websites, which have their own privacy practices; this policy does not govern those sites.

Information supplied by customers

Customers using SEO Management, Website Deployments or software services may provide information about their own staff, customers or website users. The customer remains responsible for ensuring that it has the appropriate authority to provide that information and for deciding the purposes for which its own data is collected and used. CFS will use that information only as reasonably necessary to provide the agreed service, follow the customer’s documented instructions where applicable and meet legal obligations. The precise roles and responsibilities can depend on the service and should be clarified in the relevant agreement where customer personal data is involved.

Our SEO Management reports are intended to provide an understandable summary of available website performance information. They may contain search queries, search-performance figures, website addresses and technical observations. We treat these reports and the access used to prepare them as business-confidential information and limit access to the people involved in providing or supporting the service. Customers should similarly store reports and access credentials carefully and tell us promptly if access should be changed or revoked.

International services and transfers

Some third-party services used by a customer’s website, including Google services, may process information outside the United Kingdom. Those providers are responsible for their own service infrastructure and privacy terms. Where CFS chooses a provider to support its own operations, we will consider the appropriate safeguards for the information involved. If a customer needs particular information about a service provider used in their project, they can ask us through the contact form.

Changes to this policy

We may update this policy if our services, systems or legal obligations change. The current version will be available on this page, with its revision date shown above. For related service expectations, please read our Terms of Service.
